title: Workmanship acceptance specification: PCB1 and PCB4 assemblies
notice: Demonstration document WS-PCB-014, revision A, 10 October 2026. Written for the Spec to Inspector entry to the ASUS UGen AI League hackathon, in the style of a customer's workmanship specification. It is not a real customer's document: its parts are the boards photographed in the public VisA dataset, its limits are illustrative, and it neither quotes nor paraphrases any published standard.

zones.name: A
zones.title: Header pins, their solder joints and the crystal

clauses.title: Stray or bridging solder
clauses.source_text: Solder that has flowed or splashed to where the design puts none is nonconforming at any size and in any zone. This covers a lump or bridge of solder joining two header pins or two pads, and solder lying on a component body or on the bare board.

clauses.title: Scratch
clauses.source_text: A scratch is a line cut or scored into the surface of the board. It is nonconforming when its size exceeds the limit of the zone it lies in. Several scratches that touch or cross are measured together as one defect.

clauses.title: Missing component
clauses.source_text: Every component of the assembly shall be present: both transducers with their mesh covers, the crystal and the four header pins. An absent component, or a transducer without its cover, is nonconforming in any zone.

clauses.title: Bent header pin
clauses.source_text: The four header pins shall be straight, parallel to one another and square to the board edge. A pin bent out of line with its neighbours, or touching another pin, is nonconforming at any angle of bend.

clauses.title: Foreign material
clauses.source_text: Foreign material is anything on the part that does not belong to it and is not a component: dirt, residue, corrosion spots or tarnish. It is nonconforming when its size exceeds the limit of the zone it lies in. Spots that touch are measured together as one defect.

clauses.title: Missing component
clauses.source_text: Every component of the assembly shall be present on its pads: the receptacle, the charger integrated circuit, and each resistor, capacitor and indicator. An absent component is nonconforming in any zone.

clauses.title: Extra component or object
clauses.source_text: Nothing shall be attached to the part beyond the components of the assembly. A component on pads the design leaves empty, a loose part, a fragment of plastic or a lump of solder or adhesive is nonconforming at any size and in any zone.

clauses.title: Misplaced component
clauses.source_text: Each component shall sit square on its own pads. A component that is shifted off its pads, turned from its drawn orientation or standing on one end is nonconforming at any offset and in any zone.

clauses.title: Damaged component or board
clauses.source_text: Damage is a break in the material of a component or of the board: a torn or crushed receptacle shell, a cracked or chipped component body, a lifted pad or a gouge through the board surface. It is nonconforming at any size and in any zone.

clauses.title: Scratch
clauses.source_text: A scratch is a line cut or scored into the surface of the board or of a component. It is nonconforming when its size exceeds the limit of the zone it lies in. Several scratches that touch or cross are measured together as one defect.

clauses.title: Burn mark
clauses.source_text: A burn mark is material charred or blackened by heat, on a component or on the board. It is nonconforming at any size and in any zone.
